notes.title: Please Vote for ZANGEKI WARP - Now On Steam Greenlight!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that ASTRO PORT’s latest & greatest shooting game - [i]ZANGEKI WARP[/i] – is now up on Steam Greenlight! Check out game details below and please visit the Greenlight page and vote [b]YES[/b] to help bring this awesome game to Steam!!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=787972790
[i]ZANGEKI WARP[/i] takes place just after the events of [i]STEEL STRIDER[/i]. In this game, you take control of the hyperdimensional fighter craft ‘ZanFighter’ and use its advanced warp functions to defeat an army of space beasts controlled by an evil scientist! 

[i]ZANGEKI WARP[/i]’s warp capabilities bring a new twist to the style of [i]Gradius[/i], [i]R-Type[/i], and [i]X-Multiply[/i], and are the key to overcoming thrilling stages filled with traps and obstacles that would be impossible in regular shooting games. Use the warp functions to stop time, instantly warp through enemy fire and obstacles, and even to destroy enemies.

Greenlight approval permitting, we plan to release [i]ZANGEKI WARP[/i] on both Windows and Linux in January 2017, priced only $5.99, and it will include Steam-based achievements, online trading cards, and online leaderboards.

On behalf of everyone at Nyu Media and ASTRO PORT, [b][i]THANK YOU!!

notes.title: Please Vote 'YES' for ASTRO PORT's 'WOLFLAME' - Now on Steam Greenlight!

notes.title: Achievements & Leaderboards Updated!
notes.content:
The Windows version of Supercharged Robot VULKAISER has been updated make improvements to the achievements and leaderboards, namely:

[list][*] All of the noted broken achievements were related to game clear and this has been adjusted to resolve the issues.
[*] The leaderboards were calculating difficulty incorrectly, so fresh boards have been made (due to the nature of the issue) and the base issue has been fixed.
[*] Destroy [i]X[/i] enemies achievements now show a progress bar.[/list]

Linux versions will also be updated in the next couple of days.

Thank you to all who provided feedback in the Steam discussions group!

notes.title: STEEL STRIDER IS GREENLIT!!
notes.content:
In our experience, shooting games are generally pretty slow to be approved on Steam Greenlight, but that was fast!! Hopefully that means that you guys are enjoying ASTRO PORT’s games and looking forward to the next ones! :) THANK YOU to everyone for voting and bringing this next installment of the ASTRO SAGA to Steam! 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=491089631
For this release, we’ll be implementing dual analog controls, online leaderboards, achievements, trading cards, and should have a Linux version reading hopefully in time for simultaneous release with the Windows version. In view of the work to be done, end of October would be a realistic release date, but we will make it earlier if at all possible. Please watch for future announcements!

Once again, on behalf of everyone at Nyu Media and ASTRO PORT, THANK YOU to everyone for making this release possible!

notes.title: Please Vote for STEEL STRIDER on Steam Greenlight!
notes.content:
The fifth game in ASTRO PORT’s ASTRO SAGA series, STEEL STRIDER, is now listed for approval and in need of YOUR vote on Steam Greenlight! 

STEEL STRIDER is the follow up to GIGANTIC ARMY and pays homage to the great run and gun games such as Turrican and Super Contra, but with mouse / dual analogue stick-operated weapons. It also contains many nods, winks, and cameos from other ASTRO PORT games, so fans of the series should particularly enjoy this installment :)

We would love to bring this game to Steam, but we have to pass Steam Greenlight first! Please take a moment to vote YES at the below link and bring STEEL STRIDER to Steam!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=491089631

On behalf of everyone at Nyu Media & ASTRO PORT, [i]THANK YOU[/i]!
